SELECT m.code, m.name, m.spec, m.sub_category, (SELECT split_part(i.item_nm, ' — ', 1) FROM tb_common_code_item i JOIN tb_common_code_group g ON g.common_code_group_id = i.group_id AND g.group_code = 'SUB_MATERIAL_CATEGORY' JOIN tb_tenant t ON t.tenant_id = g.tenant_id AND t.tenant_code = 'SONGYEON' WHERE i.item_code = sub_category LIMIT 1) AS sub_category_nm, m.unit, (SELECT i.item_nm FROM tb_common_code_item i JOIN tb_common_code_group g ON g.common_code_group_id = i.group_id AND g.group_code = 'UNIT' JOIN tb_tenant t ON t.tenant_id = g.tenant_id AND t.tenant_code = 'SONGYEON' WHERE i.item_code = unit LIMIT 1) AS unit_nm,
COALESCE((SELECT e.name FROM employees e WHERE e.id = m.reg_user_id), m.reg_user_id) AS reg_user_nm, TO_CHAR(m.reg_dt, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS reg_dt, COALESCE((SELECT e.name FROM employees e WHERE e.id = m.upd_user_id), m.upd_user_id) AS upd_user_nm, TO_CHAR(m.upd_dt, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS upd_dt, m.use_yn, m.unit_price, m.stock_qty, m.safety_stock, m.base_order_qty, m.client_code AS supplier, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM products p WHERE p.film_material_code = m.code OR p.pouch_material_code = m.code OR p.box_material_code = m.code) AS used_by_count, sp.supplier_name, sp.supplier_codes, sp.supplier_names FROM materials m
LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT string_agg(COALESCE(c.name, '삭제된 업체(' || e.code || ')'), ', ' ORDER BY e.ord) AS supplier_name, array_agg(e.code ORDER BY e.ord) AS supplier_codes, array_agg(COALESCE(c.name, '삭제된 업체(' || e.code || ')') ORDER BY e.ord) AS supplier_names FROM jsonb_array_elements_text( CASE WHEN replace(COALESCE(m.client_code, ''), ' ', '') ~ '^[[]("[0-9]+"(,"[0-9]+")*)?[]]$' THEN m.client_code::jsonb ELSE '[]'::jsonb END ) WITH ORDINALITY AS e(code, ord) LEFT JOIN clients c ON c.client_code = e.code ) sp ON TRUE WHERE m.sub_category IS NOT NULL AND m.sub_category != ''
AND m.sub_category = #{_parameter}
ORDER BY m.sub_category, m.name
